{{Quote|I don't sense any danger here.''"<br />"''The danger you can't sense is usually the most deadly, Master Fisto.''"<br />"''Succinct. Was that one of Yoda's?''"<br />"''No, it's one of mine.|Kit Fisto and Keelyvine Reus|<ref name="aoi" />}}
'''Keelyvine Reus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She had the tutelage of the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tyzen Xebec]] foisted upon her during the conflict after Xebec's former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]], was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]. She was teamed with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Dron]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] on an expedition to the vital [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]], which supplied the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] with [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] supplies. The emergence of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] "[[Doctor (tactical droid)|Doctor]]," and his [[Project Instinction|plot]] to ruin the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] crops resulted in an [[Battle of Ukio|engagement]], with the Republic emerging victorious thanks to the actions of Xebec and Reus, among others.

Reus's next mission with Xebec involved her being [[Mission to the Valsedian asteroid belt|dispatched]] to the [[Valsedian asteroid belt]], which was home to a key [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation that had allegedly been sold to the Confederacy by [[Torpo]] the Hutt. As the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] was held by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], there was a diplomatic sensitivity that [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was loathe to breach. Reus and Xebec, along with Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Jedi Knight [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his own Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] infiltrated the asteroid belt's mining facility, before breaking up to better determine the nature of the supposed Confederate presence there. As a result, Reus encountered Confederate agent [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], and fought a duel with the woman, discovering in the process that Torpo was in fact a patsy in a scheme of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] design. The Jedi were nonetheless able to liberate the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] workers at the facility.

==Biography==
===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|What would the Separatists want with this world? They don't have an army to feed.''"<br />"''No, but we do, Padawan.|Keelyvine Reus and Tyzen Xebec|<ref name="aoi" />}}
Keelyvine Reus was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], who was instructed in the art of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]&mdash;a hard task-master who demanded excellence from the young woman.<ref name="tvo" /> Reus later served as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In that pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict, during which the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] battled the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for supremacy, Reus was forced to take a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner, [[Tyzen Xebec]], a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] male. Xebec's former Jedi Master, [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]], had been [[Death/Legends|slain]] by the Confederate-allied [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] in the wake of a [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|battle]] at [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]], and so Reus took Ropal's place as the Zabrak's instructor. She had also inherited Ropal's [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]], one nicknamed [[Ganch]]. Teamed with fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], as well as [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Dron]], Reus commanded a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] consisting of a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] and two [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class frigates]].<ref name="aoi" />

[[File:UkioBriefing-AoI.png|thumb|left|200px|Reus and Xebec receive orders from Mace Windu and Obi-Wan Kenobi.]]
The fleet was dispatched to [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]], a vital [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] that supplied the Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] with food. Upon being informed of their arrival by Dron, Reus instructed the Admiral to have her [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] form a sentry line, while the fleet was to be placed on yellow alert. Fisto could not detect any hint of danger, but Reus was adamant that any danger that they could not sense would prove the most potent. [[Unidentified clone naval officer (Ukio)|A clone]] informed Reus that they were receiving an incoming intelligence update from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Reus halted the briefing until Xebec was summoned to the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]].<ref name="aoi" />

Reus and Fisto were contacted by Masters [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and upon Xebec's arrival, the briefing commenced. The Jedi, along with Dron, conferred with Coruscant as to the background of Ukio's involvement in the war. Windu informed them that Ukio was not only vital to the Republic, but that it also supplied the entire [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] and [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] with food. The planet had attempted to secede from the Republic just prior to the opening of the Clone Wars, but had been prevented from doing so by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. Kenobi noted that the citizenry were still divided, and that the planet was in enough [[Politics/Legends|political]] turmoil that it might attract the attention of Confederate agents such as [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], or even the enemy figurehead,<ref name="aoi" /> her old saber instructor [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku.<ref name="tvo" /> Xebec was curious as to why the Confederacy would be interested in Ukio, as their [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] had no mouths to feed&mdash;Reus pointedly reminded him that their objective was likely stopping the Republic's supply rather than claiming the crops for themselves.<ref name="aoi" />

[[Clone Intelligence/Legends|Clone Intelligence]] had determined that Ukio was indeed possibly being targeted by the Confederacy, but aiding the Republic was the fact that the planet was protected by a powerful [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]]. Consulting a readout, Reus noted that the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] would be strong enough to deflect a considerable enemy [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombardment]], and that was what puzzled Kenobi&mdash;there had been no reports of any major Confederate fleet movements anywhere near Ukio. Windu instructed the Jedi to perform reconnaissance and inspect the situation on the planet surface. He suspected that there might be Confederate sympathizers or saboteurs among the [[Ukian/Legends|Ukians]], and Reus obeyed. Conferring with Fisto after the meeting, Reus decided that the fleet should retain [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] patrol, in case the intelligence reports were erroneous, and that they should perform [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] analysis on the planetary shield to hunt for weak spots. Reus instructed her Padawan to take a team to Ukio's surface and survey the planetary defenses. As Xebec departed, Reus confided in Fisto her feelings that the Padawan was reckless and lacked focus. The [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] assured her that she would eventually be able to connect with him, in time, through the Force.<ref name="aoi" />

===Confederate machinations===
{{Quote|Master, how did you find me? How did you get past the shields?''"<br />"''Two questions, one answer, Padawan. When I couldn't reach you, I called Ganch. ''[&hellip;]'' But I reached someone else instead. A rather spirited young AgriCorps worker who led me to you and lowered the shields for me.|Tyzen Xebec and Keelyvine Reus|<ref name="aoi" />}}
Dron soon alerted Reus and Fisto to an incoming signal. The Ukian [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] network had detected a lone Confederate [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] over Ukio's horizon, and Reus was concerned by the development. The lone Confederate [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] presence was suspicious, but could not inflict any real damage on Ukio's shield. Fisto suspected that it was a lure to pull the fleet to the other side of the planet, and so Reus ordered Dron to hold their current position while she and Fisto would perform reconnaissance in their [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]]. Deploying in [[Keelyvine Reus's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor|her personal fighter]], Reus was joined by Fisto as they headed toward the enemy [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]].<ref name="aoi" />

Upon reaching the enemy craft, Reus observed that it was deploying modified [[Seismic tank/Legends|seismic tanks]], which she detected were unarmed. She was puzzled as to just what the [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] were doing, and they subsequently approached the planetary shield, deploying a cloudy black substance all over it. Fisto attempted to run a diagnostic of the substance before moving to engage the tanks. Reus soon realized that destroying the tanks would not prevent them from releasing the substance, so while Fisto transmitted his diagnostic material back to the fleet, she had her [[Unidentified R4 unit (Ukio)|astromech droid]] try and reach Dron. The communication between her and Dron was fragmented, however, as the battleship was [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] most frequencies. The admiral informed her that he had forwarded Fisto's material to the other ships in the fleet, and that they had made several findings. Acknowledging Dron's message, Reus and Fisto headed back to the fleet so that they could communicate clearly.<ref name="aoi" />

[[File:ReusFistoDronBriefing.png|thumb|right|200px|Reus, Fisto, and Dron listen to a briefing by Captain Pharl McQuarrie.]]
Back on the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], Reus and Fisto joined Dron in listening to a report from [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Pharl McQuarrie/Legends|Pharl McQuarrie]]. The captain had determined that the substance was soil from the [[Moorja/Legends|Moorjan]] badlands&mdash;an electro-static compound that would cling to the planetary shield. Reus was curious as to whether the soil was doing any actual damage&mdash;McQuarrie assured her that it was not. However, the soil was in fact photoreactive, causing it to move across the shield in tandem with the planet's orbit; in effect, the soil would continually block out Ukio's sun, no matter how the planet rotated. Reus immediately understood the implications&mdash;by creating a perpetual eclipse, the Confederacy would stop the vital sunlight from shining on the Ukian crops, which in turn would cause them to die out.<ref name="aoi" />

Breaking through the jamming signals, Reus established contact with the [[Ukian/Legends|Ukian]] [[Unidentified liege|Liege]]. She informed him of the situation, and he was not at all pleased&mdash;the crops of Ukio were highly sensitive, and could not be robbed of any more sunlight. Despairing, the [[Overliege|liege]] suggested that they drop the shield in order to disperse the Moorjan dirt, but Reus, as well as Ganch, who was with the liege, advised against such an action, as it was probably exactly what the Confederate forces wanted him to do. The Ukian protested, however, pointing out that the Republic would soon have nothing more to defend. Reus consulted McQuarrie to make sure that the liege's plan would work&mdash;the captain confirmed that it would indeed scatter the Moorjan soil to the Ukian winds. Reus relented and instructed the liege to drop the shields fifteen [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] from that time, in a size only as large as the cloud and as briefly as possible. Meanwhile, she ordered Dron to take the fleet to the Confederate battleship, reminding him that time was of the essence. As they neared the battleship, they would lose all communications due to the jamming, and they needed to be there when the shield was dropped to ensure that no enemy craft would make it through. The Jedi also deigned that the destruction of the battleship would be an objective.<ref name="aoi" />

===Battle at Ukio===
{{Quote|But just what ''did'' the Separatists do to this planet?|Keelyvine Reus|<ref name="aoi" />}}
[[File:BattleOfUkio-AoI.png|thumb|left|200px|Reus and Fisto lead the attack on enemy forces.]]
Reus returned to her [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]], and with Fisto accompanying her, led [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]], comprised of [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]], into [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] against the ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship. She instructed her fellow [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilots]] to close up their formation in order to allow her flagship an open line of fire. As they made their approach, the Liege dropped the shields on schedule, dispersing the cloud. This prompted the enemy battleship to deploy [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] to [[Battle of Ukio|engage]] the Republic fighters. A vicious and chaotic dogfight broke out, as Reus and her [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] fought both enemy [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and the remaining seismic tanks. As the carnage continued, a trio of Confederate [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttles]] broke through the hole in the shield and were able to land on Ukio.<ref name="aoi" />

As the battle raged in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], Reus attempted to contact Xebec, but the communications were still jammed. Eventually, the Confederate battleship was destroyed, bringing an end to the signal jamming. Fisto was relieved, but the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] ionization continued to prevent Reus from contacting Xebec. She decided that they would have to make their way toward the surface and see for themselves what was happening on Ukio. To that end, she resolved to meet up with her Padawan directly. Attempting to contact Ganch, she was instead put through to an [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] worker named [[Sanya]], who directed Reus to her Padawan and lowered the planetary shields.<ref name="aoi" />

[[File:Reus_saves_Xebec.png|thumb|right|200px|Reus rescues her new Padawan.]]
The Jedi Knight found her Padawan battling Confederate troops near a landed ''Sheathipede''-class [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] in an Ukian field. He had destroyed a series of [[Project Instinction device|devices]] that had prompted most beings on Ukio to go berserk and violently turn against their true nature. Although Xebec had been able to dispatch the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], he had been cornered and disarmed by the Confederate mastermind, a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] known as "[[Doctor (tactical droid)|Doctor]]." As the droid closed in on the unarmed Xebec, Reus approached, [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] drawn, and dispatched the enemy commander. Reus, glad that her Padawan was unharmed, explained how she had located him, and commended him for his actions. Ganch had been among those affected by the Doctor's devices, but had been successfully detained by Xebec.<ref name="aoi" />

After the battle, Reus joined Fisto, Xebec, and Sanya at a landing pad for debriefing. The effects of the Doctor's devices had been localized and temporary&mdash;health checks indicated that most workers and [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] had regained mental stability. Reus instructed Xebec to have Ganch round up all of the waylaid [[gigaun]] herds that had run rampant during the incursion. She also applauded Sanya's efforts, before the group were approached by the liege. The Ukian was furious and demanded that the Republic forces leave immediately. He had been stripped of his position following the tumultuous events, and as his last official act, it was his formal request that the Republic leave Ukio. As it turned out, the Ukian stock had plummeted as a result of the battle, allowing [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] to purchase the planet itself, placing it directly under Confederate control.<ref name="aoi" />

===Respite on Coruscant===
{{Quote|He casts a long shadow.''"<br />"''Well, he is awfully tall.|Keelyvine Reus and Obi-Wan Kenobi, commenting on Dooku|<ref name="tvo" />}}
Reus, Xebec, Sanya, and Ganch returned to Coruscant aboard the ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], ''[[Selfless]]''. Before debarking, Reus assured Sanya that her service on Ukio would be mentioned to the Jedi Council. Ganch reported that he had fully recovered from his earlier ordeal, before the group was approached by clone [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], bearing a priority message from the Council&mdash;Reus and Xebec were to report to the Jedi Temple immediately. With Ganch and Sanya taking leave to make use of the [[Republic Service Organization]], the two Jedi departed for the temple. There they met Jedi Masters Yoda and Kenobi, as well as [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his Padawan, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was also in attendance in the briefing room via hologram, in addition to the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].<ref name="tvo" />

Palpatine commenced the briefing, claiming that there were concerns around the Republic's alliance with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. One of the most influential members of the cartel, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], had aired concerns over one of his distant cousins, [[Torpo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], who had made a deal with the Confederacy. Reus's immediate concern was any Republic [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] that might be in jeopardy, but Palpatine assuaged her fears, as the issue was not as critical as that. The area in contention was the [[Valsedian asteroid belt]], which was a key source of ore that was used as fuel for vehicles and weaponry. According to law, the asteroid belt would remain under Hutt control, but could not be sold to the Confederacy, which was where Torpo had apparently transgressed. The nature of the alliance with the cartel prevented a proper investigation into Jabba's intelligence, and also stopped the Republic from sending a full military force to ascertain the nature of the Confederate presence at Valsedian. A small task force of Jedi would be [[Mission to the Valsedian asteroid belt|sent]] instead, comprising of Reus, Xebec, Skywalker, Kenobi, and Tano, under the cover of passing as smugglers.<ref name="tvo" />

The duty of leading the investigation and any potential negotiations fell to Generals Reus and Kenobi, while Skywalker would do the piloting. Before departing, Reus contacted Ganch and informed him that he would not be required for the operation of Valsedian. Reus then made her way to the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] and mused upon the bust of Dooku that sat there,<ref name="tvo" /> the last of the [[Lost Twenty/Legends|Lost Twenty]] to be immortalized there.<ref name="aotcvd">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Kenobi joined her, and the pair briefly discussed the man who was now the figurehead of the enemy, before discussing the nature of the mission itself, and the political baggage it entailed&mdash;an element that Reus did not relish at all. The group took Skywalker's [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|G9 Rigger freighter]] [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], with [[Anakin Skywalker's red Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor|his]] ''Aethersprite''-class interceptor kept in the hold, and departed Coruscant.<ref name="tvo" />

===The Valsedian Operation===
[[File:VentresReusDuel-TVO.png|thumb|left|200px|Reus duels Ventress in the Valsedian asteroid belt.]]
As the ''Twilight'' approached the asteroid belt, Skywalker boarded his interceptor and flew independently, serving as a contingency should negotiations on the prime asteroid take a turn for the worse. Xebec piloted them towards the asteroid and landed the freighter within a cave. As there was no breathable atmosphere, the Jedi were forced to don [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]]. As the narrow tunnels of the asteroid were playing havoc with their [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] readings, Kenobi instructed Tano and Zybec to investigate some of the smaller tunnels, as their smaller stature would allow them to sufficiently navigate. Reus took umbage at Kenobi instructing her Padawan without prior consultation, as in her opinion the young Zabrak required "special consideration." As Kenobi and Reus entered an area featuring artificial atmosphere, they encountered a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]. Wasting no time, Reus brandished one of her lightsabers, and demanded that the Twi'lek take them to his master. The Twi'lek protested, claiming that his master, though in charge of the mining operation, was far from Valsedian. As Kenobi manacled their new captive to the wall, the Twi'lek identified himself as [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]].<ref name="tvo" />

The Jedi, believing the Twi'lek to be dim-witted, persisted with their questioning until Kenobi detected that the Padawans were in danger. As he left to investigate, Reus attempted to glean further information from the Twi'lek, asking where Torpo was located. The captive Twi'lek revealed that Torpo was present on the asteroid, confusing the Jedi Knight. At that moment, [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Confederate agent Asajj Ventress emerged, brandishing [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers/Legends|her lightsabers]]. Reus, igniting her own weapons, engaged Ventress in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], attacking the Confederate with aggression that surprised her opponent. The pair bandied words as they fought, Reus recognizing her opponent's paired lightsabers as a mark of Dooku's tutelage. Although Ventress claimed to fear nothing when challenged, Reus recalled her own experiences as Dooku's pupil, and could recognize that her opponent feared him as she did in her youth.<ref name="tvo" />

As the duel progressed, Ventress cut the Twi'lek captive free, urging him to depart. The combatants progressed towards an area with artificial walls&mdash;reaching a deadlock in the contest, Ventress slashed at the walls with her weapon, revealing the captive Torpo. The Hutt, in a state of panic, urged Reus to evacuate him and remove the Confederate forces from Valsedian. As the Jedi Knight and Hutt conversed, Ventress moved around behind the captive, thrusting her weapons through Torpo's back, killing him instantly. Reus was puzzled by the development, allowing Ventress to [[Telekinesis/Legends|hurl her into a wall]] with the Force. Ventress then flung Torpo's corpse into the Jedi Knight, holding her captive until the Confederate agent could make her escape.<ref name="tvo" />

Reus eventually prised herself free, making her way to one of the asteroid's docking bays to find that Kenobi, Xebec and Tano had liberated the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] workers being held captive by Ventress's thugs, and Skywalker had destroyed the enemy's Vulture droid contingent. As Reus revealed Torpo's fate, one of the Ugnaughts noted that Torpo was not the true master of the mining operation&mdash;rather, Torpo never acted without direction from Bib Fortuna. Skywalker was familiar with Fortuna, and identified him as one of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's henchmen. Reus revealed that Fortuna had escaped during her duel with Ventress&mdash;Skywalker was outraged that they had been played for fools by Jabba, who had perpetrated the sale of Valsedian to the Confederacy and arranged to have the Jedi tie up the "loose ends." Upon returning to Coruscant, Reus and Xebec were reunited with Ganch and Sanya, who had spent their leave time hunting a [[Unidentified Republic Service Organization saboteur|saboteur]] who had plotted to kill clone troopers at the RSO.<ref name="tvo" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:ReusKenobiRepartee-TVO.png|thumb|right|180px|Reus was less than impressed with Kenobi's tutelage of Anakin Skywalker.]]
{{Quote|What are you doing here?''"<br />"''I came to see if you were all right. I am pleased to see that you are.|Tyzen Xebec and Keelyvine Reus|<ref name="aoi" />}}
Keelyvine Reus was a stern and succinct Jedi, and she shared her own philosophy openly with Master Kit Fisto. He mistook it for a saying of Master Yoda's, but she humorlessly informed him otherwise. Reus was not amused by Fisto's more flippant attitude,<ref name="aoi" /> nor did she appreciate the same trait held by Obi-Wan Kenobi. Reus bemoaned the attitudes of both Kenobi and Skywalker, particularly their constant banter. She also took several opportunities to criticize Skywalker in particular, both for his relationship with Palpatine and his complaining that he had predicted the Valsedian scenario, where Jabba Desilijic Tiure's hand was revealed&mdash;the Jedi Knight chose to make a disparaging comment about Skywalker's status as the "[[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]]."<ref name="tvo" /> Reus continually chose not to humor her fellow Jedi when they wanted to make light of a given situation.<ref name="tvo" /><ref name="aoi" />

Reus's relationship with her Padawan, Tyzen Xebec, was strained, and she had little tolerance for his tardiness, feeling that he was unfocused and reckless by nature. She confided her misgivings to Fisto, but he assured her that there was no single way to [[Jedi training/Legends|train]] a Padawan and that she would find her own path.<ref name="aoi" /> Later, Reus bristled when Kenobi issued instructions to her Padawan&mdash;it was her belief that Xebec required special instruction, and that independence was not always an asset at this stage in his development. Kenobi claimed that independence in a Padawan was vital, but Reus disagreed, again citing the example of how Skywalker had matured as a sufficient counterexample.<ref name="tvo" />

When faced with a threatening situation, such as the arrival of a Confederate craft at Ukio, Reus acted decisively, deciding to perform reconnaissance tasks personally.<ref name="aoi" /> She was of a singular focus, borne from learning lightsaber combat from Dooku, a master who loathed apathy and demanded perfection from his students. Her apprenticeship to Dooku caused her to fear failing her instructor, a trait that she recognized in Asajj Ventress when encountering her on Valsedian.<ref name="tvo" /> Focus and dedication to the task at hand was a common theme for Reus: When Fisto began to believe that Reus was starting to care about her Padawan, she brushed it off as being concern for the mission objectives.<ref name="aoi" /> On the Valsedian operation, Reus was disinterested in any method of subterfuge of clandestine behavior, and did not hesitate to brandish her weapon at Bib Fortuna upon first encountering him. When battling Ventress, she exhibited an unusual level of aggression for a Jedi&mdash;her opponent was also surprised by Reus's reluctance to talk during the engagement.<ref name="tvo" /> Later in the Ukio operation, however, Reus did show she did care for Xebec's well-being, and was relieved to find him safe. She also praised his efforts during the battle, as he had been able to almost single-handedly defeat the Confederate incursion. Additionally, the Jedi was highly impressed with the conduct of the AgriCorps worker Sanya during the battle.<ref name="aoi" />

==Powers and abilities==
During the opening stages of the battle at Ukio, Keelyvine Reus demonstrated her combat ability by destroying several of the orbiting seismic tanks.<ref name="aoi" /> In addition, she was a skilled lightsaber combatant, particularly in [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]] as she wielded two lightsabers. Having been trained by Dooku in the art of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], she was able to match another of Dooku's students, Asajj Ventress in a duel.<ref name="tvo" /> Reus was also able to dispatch the Confederate leader "Doctor" with her sabers.<ref name="aoi" />

==Equipment==
Keelyvine Reus wielded twin lightsabers, and also owned a Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor, which she piloted ably.<ref name="aoi" />

==Appearance and attire==
Keelyvine Reus wore green, non-traditional garments as opposed to standard [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]],<ref name="aoi" /> over which she would sometimes wear a cloak.<ref name="tvo" /> She also wore green lipstick, which matched her green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Her hair was brown, which she pinned in a bun behind her head, with two hair sticks.<ref name="aoi" />

==Behind the scenes==
Keelyvine Reus was first introduced in Part Five of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|webcomic]] ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', published in [[2009]]. The character was designed by [[Tom Hodges|Thomas Hodges]] and named by [[Pablo Hidalgo]], who illustrated and wrote the comic, respectively.<ref name="Hodges DeviantArt">{{DeviantArt|username=Hodges-Art|url=comments/1/143332848/1745859447|name=Thomas Hodges|text=Jedi Master Keelyvine Reus|quote=It's very Star Wars, isn't it? While I designed her, I did not come up with her name. Pablo Hidalgo, my boss at Lucasfilm did.}}</ref> In Part Five of ''Act on Instinct'', she is mistakenly called "[[General/Legends|General]] Geus" by a [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone naval officer]] in a single frame. The character later appears in the [[2010]] sequel to ''Act on Instinct'', ''[[The Clone Wars: The Valsedian Operation]]'', which was developed at a story level by Hodges, and scripted by Hidalgo.
